title: Official Metadata Addon Scraper Architecture Deepening
compatibility_policy: Breaking changes are allowed when they produce cleaner internal Interfaces or explicit schema-versioned task/output contracts.
continue_policy: Keep this lane closed. Open a new workstream for additional provider waves, Nako core refresh/locked-field policy, local metadata/artwork priority, persistent provider cache/rate-limit policy, or release packaging.
closeout_summary: All six architecture-review candidates are implemented: typed scrape outcome, render intent, rendered AV flow, provider quality descriptors, resolver/fusion split, and shared side-effect writeback state machine.
